headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis to provide instant feedback on potential risks, improve user experience through a more intuitive interface, and expand support for additional package managers like Go and Ruby.
actions: Implement real-time dependency analysis to flag potential security vulnerabilities or compatibility issues before installation, enhancing risk visibility.
Develop a more intuitive UI/UX that clearly displays the impact of each dependency on the local environment, making it easier for users to understand and manage
Expand support for additional package managers such as Go and Ruby, ensuring ClearInstall remains comprehensive across different development ecosystems.
